facts.fact: Addis Fortune reports Wingu.Africa signed lease agreements with five banking and ICT companies for rack space at its completed first-phase (100 racks) data centre in the Ethio ICT Park, Addis Ababa; agreements announced the week before the 2022-03-26 article, and services to new customers were due the following month.
